title: Typikon Coded Nested Triodion Asset Database
description: Strict schema for 3-level nested Triodion text assets (text_lenten_triodion.json and text_floral_triodion.json) consumed by engine/text_db.py::_resolve_variable_ref.

^[a-z0-9_]+$.description: Liturgical day key (e.g., sunday_of_the_publican_and_the_pharisee, palm_sunday, thomas_sunday).

additionalProperties.description: Ordered list of hymn/rubric text paragraphs for the variable slot (e.g., stichera_on_lord_i_have_cried, troparia, sessional_hymns).
